why: The fixture has no vector index, so this is the arm every server hits first and the one whose flag matters most. A server that answered without `degraded` here would be claiming a vector space it does not have. `degraded_reason` must say `no_index` and not `no_vector_support` even on a build with no vector support at all: the corpus is missing the artefact, which is the repair either way, and pinning the nearer cause is what keeps this case answerable identically by every build of every server.
